title: Dibenzo-18-crown-6/poly-2-aminobenzenethiol based potentiometric sensor for diltiazem determination: greenness assessment
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,12915-12926
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07743E, Paper

Ghada Ahmed El Sayed, Sahar Mahmoud Mostafa, Mohamed Rabia, Mohamed Ali Korany, Mohamed Magdy Khalil
A green, cost-efficient, highly selective, and sensitive carbon paste potentiometric sensor for Diltiazem hydrochloride (DTZ) is developed, characterized, and applied for drug monitoring.
